name: Callsign
teaser: This mod changes the names of PMCs in the game to make them sound more similar to online as well as interesting. The mod replaces the default bot names with names that are more fitting for the game like its online counterpart.
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
There are other Bot Naming mods out there and here they are:

In fact, this is basically the first mod IMMERSIVE BOT NAMES (by VirtualHex) with updated names. All credit goes to those who came before me. The names are a bit raunchy at times some a bit more naughty. However, I feel this represents the online game very well and creates an atmosphere more similar to the game rather than these extremely strange and ordinary names that you know DAMN well no one would use in the game.

Examples:

  • CumInHeadEye
  • BojibTTV
  • BSG_FIX_UR_GAME
  • 8cmOfTrueDamage
  • ISimp4Killa
  • NotInTheFace
  • ScavsAteMyLegs
  • 50ShadesOfChad
  • KinkyTagilla
  • TheFourInchKing

The mod changes the names of the AI-controlled BEAR and USEC in the game, giving them unique names. The mod includes a large database of names to draw from, ensuring that each bot has a unique name. The mod is fully customizable, allowing users to customize the list of names. Just edit the files in the cfg folder and update the lists using the format given in the lists. The last name on the list does not need a “,” after it.

Overall, the Callsign mod is a great addition to anyone trying to bring the online feel to SPT AKI for players who want to add more personality and depth to the game’s AI-controlled bots.

INSTALL:
Place into your SPTAKI folder/user/mods just drop the whole folder inside.

NOTE: SPT REALISM MOD has a setting for names if you use those settings it will interfere with this mod specifically giving them weird last names. Also Poopz for some can cause your own name to appear as well.

DISCLAIMER: ANY NAMES THAT SEEM LIKE YOURS ARE PURE COINCIDENCE AND TOTALLY NOT INTENTIONAL. ALSO IF YOU ARE EASILY OFFENDED DON’T DOWNLOAD IT! A LOT OF THESE ARE REAL NAMES PLAYERS USED AND SOME WERE ACTUALLY SO OFFENSIVE I HAD TO REMOVE THEM. PERSONALLY I THINK FOR THE MOST PART FUNNY AS HELL.
